title: DelegationRevocationHead (v1)
description: The relay's signed snapshot of every DelegationRevocation it holds for one delegator up to `seq_high_water`, answering one consumer challenge (standing-delegation@1.3). The only source of 'absent as of `as_of`'; never confers authority. Guarantees integrity, freshness and relay accountability — NOT completeness against omission, NOT non-equivocation. Canonicalization: JCS (RFC 8785). Signature: Ed25519 over canonicalJson(body minus signature), base64url. See spec/standing-delegation-v1.md §5.2.

spec.description: Artifact discriminator (domain separation from every other relay-signed artifact).

relay_public_key.description: The relay's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase). Consumers compare it to the key they pin.

delegator_id.description: The delegator whose revocations this head covers. Every entry's `record.delegator_id` MUST equal it.

challenge.description: The consumer-chosen challenge, echoed verbatim. A head without the consumer's challenge answers no request of theirs.

as_of.description: Unix ms at which the relay assembled the head. Consumers MUST refuse a head older than their freshness window plus clock skew, or newer than clock skew.

seq_high_water.description: The relay's highest assigned receipt sequence number at `as_of`. Every entry's `seq` MUST be ≤ it. Consumers MUST refuse a head below one they already accepted from the same relay key (rollback).

seq.description: The relay's receipt sequence number for this record (positive integer). Entries are strictly ascending by `seq`.

received_at.description: Unix ms, the relay's receipt clock — never the signer-asserted `revoked_at`.

delegator_id.description: Delegator's motebit identity. MUST equal the grant's delegator.

delegator_public_key.description: Delegator's Ed25519 public key, hex-encoded (64 lowercase). Verifies `signature`. To bind a grant, MUST equal that grant's `delegator_public_key`.

revoked_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the grant was revoked.

suite.description: Cryptosuite identifier. Always `motebit-jcs-ed25519-b64-v1`: JCS (RFC 8785), Ed25519, base64url signature, hex public keys.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over `canonicalJson(body)` (this object minus `signature`). Verify with `delegator_public_key`.

record.description: The DelegationRevocation exactly as the delegator signed it. Authoritative over a grant only through the §5.1 binding check (grant_id + delegator key + signature).

entries.description: Every revocation the relay holds for `delegator_id` with `seq <= seq_high_water`, strictly ascending by `seq`.

records_digest.description: hex(SHA-256(canonicalJson(entries))), 64 lowercase. Excludes `challenge` and `as_of`, so two heads at the same `seq_high_water` are comparable by digest (equivocation evidence).

suite.description: Cryptosuite identifier. Always `motebit-jcs-ed25519-b64-v1`: JCS (RFC 8785), Ed25519, base64url signature, hex public keys.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature over `canonicalJson(body)` (this object minus `signature`), by `relay_public_key`. Verify against the relay key the consumer PINS — the embedded key alone proves nothing.
